name: Default environmental damage
notes: Numbers from mw-e04.19 (placeholders until the combat sandbox tunes them). Falls: no damage up to a 4 m drop, then linear to 100% of max health at 14 m, so a 9 m fall costs half; landing in liquid 1.5 m deep or more is safe. Heights are equivalent drops (speed² / 2g with the character's own gravity), which also prices launches and walls: at the player's 25 m/s² a landing is safe up to 14.1 m/s and lethal from 26.5 m/s (mw-e02.15 sketched 8 and 20 m/s at real-world gravity, where they are the same 3.3 m and 20 m drops). Kinetic impacts: a physics object striking a creature faster than 6 m/s deals blunt ½·m·v²/20, so a 40 kg chandelier dropped 5 m (about 9.9 m/s) deals about 98. Fire: anything burning deals 8 fire per second to creatures within 0.75 m of it (the fire rules' flame reach), in 250 ms pulses of 2.
